surfaces.part: rusty sheet, concrete lumps, glass shards and cable lying on the earth

answer.evidence: The silhouette is 64 px wide on every row (0-47), so it is a full-bleed ground patch with no standing volume. The brown earth texture runs the whole height, with no front-edge line, eave shadow, or south face. The column scans show only earth tones, scattered dark oil stains, and small grey, blue-grey and rust debris specks (rows 1-15 and 38-43). These pieces lie on the ground and have no vertical face. This is a flat top-down decal, which matches the 'flat' kind.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate carries 5 visible tones per tile, above the grass reference (3) and below the paving reference (7). Near-flat coverage is 0%, so no 5x5 area is a single flat colour, and the soil shows mottled speckle and grain. Only 2% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the dark edges lean brown and rust and are not a black sticker line. The debris (metal, concrete, glass, cable) has a few shade steps and sits on the soil without a heavy outline. Weaknesses: the debris clusters look like copies of one small sprite, the oil stain barely reads as a separate darker ramp, and the ground is a little less varied than the best reference. Overall it holds up beside the grass and paving references on structure and shading craft.
